description: This file contains a simple WebSocket client implemented using the 'websockets' library in Python. It defines an asynchronous function to connect to a WebSocket server, send a greeting message, and print the received response. The script initiates the event loop to run the connect function.

methods.name: connect()
methods.description: Asynchronous function that connects to a WebSocket server at ws://localhost:8080, sends a greeting message, and prints the server's response.
